rules.statement: A party with regard to whose title an order has been made prior to the date when the Interlocutory decree is entered, may appeal against the Interlocutory decree when that decree is in fact entered by the District Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear from this decision that a party with regard to whose title an order has been made prior to the date when the Interlocutory decree is entered, may appeal against the Interlocutory decree when that decree is in fact entered by the District Court."
